name: context-os
description: Claude Code context optimizer. Builds a local static repo graph, injects ranked file:line candidates through a UserPromptSubmit hook, and adds a SessionStart prewarm brief. No embeddings, no server, no telemetry. Measured live A/B: 40.9% aggregate token reduction across 36 Claude Code calls. v2.10 structural slicing: a PreToolUse hook intercepts whole-file reads and hands Claude the file's outline (symbols + exact line ranges from the graph) so it reads the 40 lines it needs, not 800 that get re-sent every turn. Receipts (/savings) measure both sources — searches avoided and big reads sliced — causally from your transcript.
